def f(g):
    from collections import Counter, OrderedDict
    flat=[v for r in g for v in r]
    order=list(OrderedDict.fromkeys(flat))
    cnt=Counter(flat)
    H=max(flat)
    out=[[0]*sum(cnt[c] for c in order) for _ in range(H)]
    col=0
    for c in order:
        for j in range(cnt[c]):
            for i in range(c):
                out[i][col+j]=c
        col+=cnt[c]
    return out
